title: Malaika Arora On Her Type: 'Rough, Flirtatious, And A Great Kisser'
text:
Malaika Arora On Her Type: 'Rough, Flirtatious, And A Great Kisser'
Curated By :
Last Updated:
On her birthday, let's revisit Malaika Arora’s bold revelation about her ideal man.
1/8
As Malaika Arora celebrates her birthday today, fans are revisiting one of her most candid and unforgettable moments—when she unapologetically described her idea of the perfect man. Known for her confidence and authenticity, Malaika didn’t hold back, and her words continue to resonate years later. (Image: Instagram)
2/8
During a 2021 appearance on a reality show, Malaika was asked about her romantic preferences. Her response was refreshingly honest: “I really like a guy who is a little rough around the edges. I like that. Too prissy, chikna nahi hota. Outrageously flirtatious. I like somebody who can kiss really well.” (Image: Instagram)
ADVERTISEMENT
3/8
The clip quickly became a fan favourite, showcasing Malaika’s fearless charm and self-assured persona. At the time, her description seemed to mirror her then-boyfriend Arjun Kapoor—rugged, playful, and effortlessly cool. The couple, together for nearly six years, were often in the spotlight for their chemistry and openness. (Image: Instagram)
4/8
In the same conversation, Malaika added that she’s turned off by men who gossip too much, preferring someone who’s confident and doesn’t indulge in idle chatter. (Image: Instagram)
ADVERTISEMENT
5/8
That mix of boldness and clarity made the moment go viral again recently, reminding fans why she remains one of Bollywood’s most authentic voices in an industry that often plays it safe. (Image: Instagram)
6/8
Adding a tender twist to this throwback is Malaika’s recent revelation that she’s still open to love—and even marriage. Her journey in relationships has been as dynamic as her career. She was married to Arbaaz Khan from 1998 to 2017, and they share a son, Arhaan. Arbaaz has since remarried makeup artist Sshura Khan, and the couple recently welcomed a baby girl. (Image: Instagram)
ADVERTISEMENT
7/8
Meanwhile, Arjun Kapoor confirmed his single status at a promotional event for Singham Again, joking, “Abhi single hoon main, relax.” Despite their breakup, both Malaika and Arjun have spoken about maintaining mutual respect and privacy. (Image: Instagram)
